The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `4444` (see `WebDriverBuilder.WebDriverPort`)
- Port: `5900` (see `WebDriverBuilder.VncServerPort`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /wd/hub/status` to port `4444` is completed successfully.
